description: Attach one of this workspace's sending mailboxes to a campaign — which mailboxes MAY carry it. Attaching sends nothing. A campaign with no attached source cannot be armed at all, so this is a required step before handing it to a human. ⚠️ Attaching a mailbox that is still WARMING succeeds, and still leaves the campaign unarmable: the send loop claims active sources only, so activation refuses with no_active_sources. Check state with send_list_sources and use send_promote_source to arm a matured mailbox. A mailbox this workspace does not own returns 404. Allowed while the campaign is active — adding capacity is the safe direction.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_attach_source
